scripts.typecheck: npm run build:rules && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/client/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build:rules && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && node --test packages/rules/test/*.test.mjs apps/server/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build:rules && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && concurrently -k "npm:dev:server:compile" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:rules && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && npm run build -w @ctf/client
